name: ship-session-jev
description: An add-on to ship-session that lets Jev (TypeSafe AI's System One model) classify the goal (Issue / implementation / PR / merge) from the request and skip the Phase 0 question when its confidence is high. Fully optional and fail-open: without TYPESAFE_API_KEY, or when the API fails, it behaves exactly like ship-session. Requires the ship-session plugin.
